name: Authority impersonation with isolation from family or lawyer
description: An authority impersonator instructs the recipient not to contact family or a lawyer while under threat of arrest — the isolation tactic of the digital-arrest scam.

source_references.quote: They are instructed not to involve family or lawyers

explanation.plain: Someone claiming to be an official told you not to tell your family or a lawyer. That isolation is a scam tactic — real authorities never demand secrecy from your family.
explanation.technical: ISOLATION_FROM_FAMILY_OR_LAWYER (pressure) with an authority/threat identity or accusation. NITI Aayog documents the isolation instruction verbatim.
verification_steps: Hang up and call a trusted family member now.
No real investigation forbids you from contacting a lawyer.

provenance.notes: Encoded in the WP3 rule-encoding pass; suppression via negative-indicator-library-v1.json.
